question: If 20% of k is 10 less than 1200% of 10, then k is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert **percentages** to decimals: 20% = 0.2 and 1200% = 12.

The equation becomes: 0.2 × k = (12 × 10) − 10

0.2k = 120 − 10 = 110

k = 110 ÷ 0.2 = 1100 ÷ 2 = 550

**∴ The correct answer is 550.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 20% of k = (1200% of 10) − 10

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b2aeef2ffe120a94d5dc9f7d10b99db04149ac21a12397288c90b21adb0263b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 20/100 × k = (1200/100 × 10) − 10

⇒ 1/5 × k = (12 × 10) − 10

⇒ k/5 = 120 − 10

⇒ k/5 = 110

⇒ k = 110 × 5

⇒ k = 550

**∴ The correct answer is 550.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To convert x% to a fraction, divide by 100: x/100. For example, 1200% = 1200/100 = 12.

Percentage Change Formula

Percentage change = [(New Value − Original Value) ÷ Original Value] × 100.

A% of B property

A% of B is always equal to B% of A. This can simplify many mental calculations.</p
